description: This file defines a React context for managing shopping cart state in a frontend application, including functions to load, add, update, remove, clear, and checkout cart items, interfacing with backend API endpoints.

methods.name: CartProvider({ children })
methods.description: Main component providing cart state and actions via React context.

methods.name: loadCart
methods.description: Fetches cart items from backend API and updates React state.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the cart via API call and reloads cart data.

methods.name: updateItem
methods.description: Updates a specific cart item via API call and reloads cart data.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a specific item from the cart via API call and reloads cart data.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the entire cart via API call and reloads cart data.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Performs checkout operation via API call, then reloads cart data.
